whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Sky Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has strong 4.2★ reviews with 500+ happy patrons near Bailey Road / Gola Rd, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and menu page.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, digital menu, aur location highlights integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/skycafe

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The Sky Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (The Sky Cafe near Ram Jaipal More, Bailey Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a digital menu showcase, table reservation via WhatsApp, and easy directions for patrons visiting Gola Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact food gallery, menu, aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
